Locally bundled browser dependencies (no build step or runtime CDN required):

- MapLibre GL JS 5.20.0: https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.20.0/dist/maplibre-gl.js
- MapLibre stylesheet 5.20.0: https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.20.0/dist/maplibre-gl.css
- PMTiles 4.4.0: https://unpkg.com/pmtiles@4.4.0/dist/pmtiles.js

Upstream licenses are included alongside these assets. MapLibre's distribution
also contains license notices for its dependencies in maplibre-LICENSE.txt.
